findings.summary: The simultaneous-reads test fails when the lookup and removal are split, but still passes with the lock removed, and no test races the last-read time.
An error inside the queue-read telemetry, such as an attribute outside the contract or an exporter error, would turn a queue read into a 500, because the telemetry calls are not isolated.
The ingest time is taken after the commit, so the measured delay is a few milliseconds shorter than the true ingest-to-visible time.
The watched state is global to the process, so any user's queue read counts as watching, which matches the issue text and the one-worker assumption.
The Engineer's first edit of the telemetry module used a one-off rewrite script instead of the edit tool.
